target.displayed_identity: Twitter T3 TT / 骓特 T3 铁三 TT

method: Fifty genuinely distinct registered source areas were checked once at model level, then each atomic field received a field-specific acceptance or rejection application. Public XHS was limited to search-engine indexes under shared-runtime coordination; no new XHS job, browser-profile bypass, login, CAPTCHA or security-verification action was attempted.
identity_note: The retained WheelTop EVO 24-speed mainland snapshot maps to the same T3 TT platform. The current reference configuration is now identified explicitly as WheelTop TX-TT7110 2×12 with RS 60 mm carbon rims; alternative tri-spoke/disc and SRAM builds remain separate configurations.
